notes.title: Space Machine Added!
notes.notes:
Hey Ballers,

August's update brings the Space Machine as a new, fully playable machine.

The Space Machine is the most complex machine yet, with 5 components to choose and play!

Also included in this month's update:
[list]
[*] 10 new pinballs!
[*] Saving most recent pinball and machine so you don't have to flick through everything every time!
[*] Fixed a bug with saving and starting a new game, where the unlock scores wouldn't get refreshed
[/list]

As always, if you have any suggestions, please let me know through this form!
[url=https://forms.gle/ctmRSP5AAW1iYKov8]Google Form[/url]

Thanks,
Dragonkid

notes.title: Update Notes July 31
notes.notes:
Hey Ballers,
The official first update to Pinballers is now live!

[list]
[*] Madness Machine added
[*] 11 New Pinball designs
[*] Code for unlocking everything: cbaplzhelp
[*] Code for resetting progress: boredplzhelp
[*] Marine Machine art updated to look prettier
[*] Circuit Machine changed so the stand at the bottom is one way collision
[/list]

Thanks for all your support,
Dragonkid
